h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Suryapet

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Suryapet

items.pText: When parents bring children to a park in Suryapet, many of them would exercise too if there were something for adults nearby. Putting play equipment and an outdoor gym in the same park serves the whole family. FunPlay Systems makes both at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 750 km away, for parks, schools and colonies in Suryapet.

Suryapet sits on the highway between Hyderabad and Vijayawada, in a hot, dry part of Telangana with a monsoon from June to September. The equipment comes by road, and a dealer in south India or our own installation team fixes it on site. Share the size of your park, photos and a note on who uses it most, morning and evening. We will suggest play and fitness equipment together on one layout drawing with every safe area marked.

richText.heading: Combining play equipment and an outdoor gym

c: Place the outdoor gym where parents can see the play area while they exercise, but keep the two zones apart with a path. Children should not run through the space around moving machines such as a pendulum or walker.

items.q: Can a park have both playground and outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. We plan both on one layout drawing, with separate zones and a clear path between them so children do not run into the space around gym machines.

items.q: Which gym machines suit parents and senior citizens?
items.a: Low-impact machines such as the Fun Walker, Tai Chi wheel and seated twisters. They use the person's own body weight and need no adjustment.
